CaseStudies.title: Results, not just screenshots.
CaseStudies.subtitle: Every project starts with a real problem -- here's how a few of them were solved.

case01.problem: Online bookings were nearly nonexistent -- most reservations still came by phone.
case01.solution: Rebuilt around a booking-first homepage with real-time table availability.

case02.problem: The existing site looked dated, which undercut credibility with higher-value clients.
case02.solution: Redesigned with a case-focused layout and clearer practice-area navigation.

case03.problem: Patients dropped off during the multi-step appointment request form.
case03.solution: Simplified to a single-step request flow with instant confirmation.
